2609.24627.title: FedMust: Semi-supervised Multi-task Student-Teacher Federated Learning for Multi-organ CT Segmentation
2609.24627.paper_summary: Multi-organ segmentation using deep learning requires large amounts of annotated patient data; however, institutions often lack sufficiently large and diverse annotated datasets. Privacy constraints further prevent institutions from sharing patient data to overcome this limitation. Moreover, due to the labor-intensive nature of annotation and the scarcity of diverse expertise, institutions typically have labels for only a small portion of their local data, leaving the larger unlabeled portion unused. In this work, we propose a flexible semi-supervised federated multi-task student-teacher framework that leverages federated learning (FL) to improve multi-organ segmentation using both labeled and unlabeled data across participating sites. At each communication round, the proposed framework initiates local training, where clients with labels for the same task form a federation to produce an aggregated teacher model. The resulting teachers generate task-specific features for all data at each client. Subsequently, all clients form a second federation to train a multi-task student model with a shared encoder and task-specific decoders that replicate the teacher-generated features across all segmentation tasks. The aggregated student model is then used to update the local teachers and initiate the next training round. Extensive experiments demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed method compared with local and federated single-organ models, yielding an average performance gain of 13 percent across clients. The experiments also demonstrated the impact of multi-task learning and unlabeled data and the applicability of the framework in relaxing labeled-data requirements for client participation. The code is available at https://github.com/AshknMrd/FedMust.
2609.24627.paper_summary_zh: 多器官分割使用深度學習需要大量標註的患者數據；然而，機構通常缺乏足夠大且多樣化的標註數據集。隱私限制進一步阻止機構共享患者數據以克服這一限制。此外，由於標註的勞動密集性和多樣化專業知識的稀缺，機構通常僅對其本地數據的一小部分進行標註，導致更大部分的未標註數據未被利用。在這項工作中，我們提出了一個靈活的半監督聯邦多任務學生-教師框架，利用聯邦學習（FL）來改善多器官分割，使用參與機構的標註和未標註數據。在每個通信回合中，所提出的框架啟動本地訓練，擁有相同任務標註的客戶形成聯邦，以生成聚合的教師模型。生成的教師為每個客戶的所有數據生成任務特定的特徵。隨後，所有客戶形成第二個聯邦，以訓練一個具有共享編碼器和任務特定解碼器的多任務學生模型，這些解碼器在所有分割任務中複製教師生成的特徵。然後，聚合的學生模型用於更新本地教師並啟動下一個訓練回合。大量實驗證明了所提出方法的有效性，與本地和聯邦單器官模型相比，客戶的平均性能提升達到13%。實驗還展示了多任務學習和未標註數據的影響，以及該框架在放寬客戶參與的標註數據要求方面的適用性。代碼可在 https://github.com/AshknMrd/FedMust 獲得。
